devdoc.details: No plaintext data is stored on-chain. Only references to encrypted payloads on Arweave and Lit access control identifiers are kept.

params._arweaveTxId: Arweave transaction ID storing the encrypted payload.
params._heartbeatInterval: Seconds the user has between check-ins before        the switch is considered triggered.
params._litAccessControlId: Identifier for the Lit access-control condition set.
params._recipient: Address that should receive the decrypted data.        Use address(0) to indicate public release.

returns._0: True if the user has not checked in within their interval.

devdoc.title: DeadMansSwitch

checkIn().notice: Update the heartbeat timestamp, proving the user is still active.

createSwitch(uint256,string,string,addre.notice: Create a new dead man's switch.

deactivateSwitch().notice: Deactivate a switch. The user can cancel their switch while alive.

getSwitchDetails(address).notice: Get the full details of a user's switch.

getSwitchOwnerCount().notice: Get the number of switch owners (for off-chain enumeration).

isDeceased(address).notice: Returns true if the user's heartbeat has expired. This is the primary function called by Lit Protocol ACCs to determine whether decryption should be authorized.

switchOwners(uint256).notice: Track all users who have created switches for enumeration

switches(address).notice: Each address may have one active switch

timeUntilTrigger(address).notice: Seconds remaining until the switch triggers (0 if already triggered).

updateSwitchMetadata(string,string).notice: Update storage references (e.g. after re-encrypting or re-uploading).

userdoc.notice: Manages heartbeat-based dead man's switches for whistleblowers. If a user fails to check in within their configured interval, the switch is considered "triggered" and encrypted data can be released via Lit Protocol Access Control Conditions that call isDeceased().
